method: For every row in compactions-4.jsonl (4213 total; this run's log carries epoch ts_start/ts_end directly, unlike soak3's host-CLOCK_MONOTONIC-only t_start/t_end, so the window IS directly epoch-comparable here -- the first soak in this campaign where this row is computable at all), formed the window [ts_start-60, ts_end+60] and collected every query_p99_ms gauge sample (metrics.jsonl, labels {reader, query}, any reader, any of the 4 query ids) whose ts falls in that window. compaction_stall_max_reader_p99_ms is the max value across every sample in every window; a window is 'non-empty' if at least one query_p99_ms sample falls inside it.
